SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3490.
Date 15/ 4/ 32

April 15 32.

Dear Sir,

With reference to your letter dated March 18,
1932, I have to state that Mrs. Olga Verhovsky at present
resides at No. 73 Route Voyron, but intends to remove
in the near future to Pass. 222, House No.19, Avenue
du Roi Albert, French Concession.

Yours faithfully,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch)
for Commissioner of Police.

C. A. Anderson, Esq.,
1532 Howard Street,
San Francisco, Calif.
U.S.A.

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3490.
Date 13 / 4 / 32）

Superintendent of Police,
Administration Bldg.
Shanghai, China

Sir Sir:

Mr Mc Pherson, constable to the
British Counsel in Shanghai (1924-25)
recommends you for assistance in locating
my wife's Sister, Mrs. Olga Verhovsky,*
c/o Meshouren, 24 Route Vallon, Shanghai.
Former address 75 Route Amiral Courbet.
Mrs Verhovsky's husband, Andre
Verhovsky* is a prize fighter, and fights
under name of "Andre Kid."
A friend of Mrs Verhovsky is Mr. J.
Gorlovsky,* c/o River Police, Pootung Point,
Shanghai.
Mrs Verhovsky has not written
to her Sister for several months. Her
husband and she do not live together,
therefore we are quite anguish for her
welfare.
Your efforts to locate Mrs. Verhovsky
will be much appreciated by my family,

* No records in C. & S. B. Registry
13/5/32. L.P.

行政大楼
中国上海

尊敬的先生：

麦克弗森先生（Mr Mc Pherson），曾任上海英国领事馆巡捕（1924-25年），推荐向贵处寻求协助，以查找我妻子的姐姐奥尔加·维尔霍夫斯基夫人*的下落，通讯处为上海瓦隆路（Route Vallon）24号梅肖伦（Meshouren，音译）转交。前住址为孤拔海军上将路（Route Amiral Courbet）75号。维尔霍夫斯基夫人的丈夫安德烈·维尔霍夫斯基*是一名职业拳击手，以“安德烈·基德”（Andre Kid）为名参赛。维尔霍夫斯基夫人的一位朋友是J. 戈尔洛夫斯基先生（Mr. J. Gorlovsky*），通讯处为上海浦东角（Pootung Point）水上警察局。维尔霍夫斯基夫人已有数月未给其姐姐写信。她与丈夫分居，因此我们非常担忧她的安危。
若蒙贵处协助查找维尔霍夫斯基夫人，我方全家将不胜感激，

* 刑事与特别股登记处无记录
1932年5月13日。 L.P.
